jobs.title: Backend Software Engineer - Apple TV Catalog
jobs.description:
What happens when the world's most innovative engineers collaborate with the world's most creative storytellers? TV gets reinvented. Meet the reinventors: The Apple Video Services teams created and manage the Apple TV app, which redefined and refined the way people watch their favorite shows, movies and so much more - including everything we love from the major subscription services. Today, these teams also manage one of the most exciting new realms at Apple: They bring viewers the critically acclaimed and award winning Apple Originals in Apple TV+. And they've engineered it so it can be enjoyed not only on Apple devices, but also directly on many new televisions and third-party streaming devices. To deliver Apple-level quality on a global scale, these engineers employ talent and tools to smoothly ingest and process a wide array of data. They work cross-functionally to handle video flow from content ingestion, store services, playback, and virtually everything else it takes to make the experience as seamless as possible. Join them to see what else is there.  
  
**Description**  
  
The Apple Video Services engineering team is responsible for building the backend services critical to the Apple TV app, which is the central hub to watch various pieces of content (Movies, TV shows, Sporting events) including those from Apple streaming service: Apple TV+ You will be working on a team valuing collaboration, design discussions and constructive code reviews. A successful candidate will be someone willing to learn the domain while challenging the existing. As a member of the team, you will be encouraged to propose, design and implement solutions, while potentially taking ownership of critical components of the stack. You will commit yourself to writing high-quality, well-tested and maintainable code. You will consider exploring new technologies and apply creative solutions to problems.  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  
3+ Years of relative industry experience.  
  
Knowledge of caching technologies, key/value stores and message queues.  
  
Advocate for test automation and software engineering best practices.  
  
Client-Server protocol & API design skills.  
  
Excellent data modeling skills.  
  
Deep understanding of distributed systems.  
  
Experience dealing with high throughput, low latency java services.  
  
Keen understanding of observability and how it helps resolve production problems.  
  
Experience with eventually consistent databases.  
  
Javascript and UI skills for building tools.  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
  
Deep knowledge of programming in Java.  
  
Ability to communicate effectively, demonstrating problem-solving skills and a strong willingness to learn.  
  
Knowledge of data structures, algorithms and design patterns.  
  
BS or higher in Computer Science or equivalent.  
  
**Pay & Benefits**  
  
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $150,400 and $277,600, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Observability
jobs.description:
The Apple Services Engineering (ASE) team is building the next generation of foundational tools that empower software developers at Apple to build products that our customers love. The Observability team within ASE is a fast moving, highly skilled team this is designing and building a suite of platforms and services that help Apple engineers observe and get insights into their systems. If the thought of working with petabytes of data interests you, this is the place to be. Our systems must scale globally, stay highly available, and “just work”, while supporting some of the largest services in world. That’s a tall order, and we’re looking to add more talented and passionate engineers who love challenges. If you’d love to join this amazing team, we’d love to hear from you.  
  
**Description**  
  
Your responsibilities will include : Requirement gathering across cross functional teams - Developing practical, fault-tolerant high-performance distributed systems. - Leading and participating in technical design discussions across cross functional teams. Gain in-depth understanding of the domain and come up with creative ideas in the domain. - Willingness to lead an independent research in the field of work. - Mentor other engineers in the team. You will have the courage and experience to be frank and ambitious but humble enough to listen to others. We want your thoughts on how we can move faster, be more creative, and deliver tools and ideas to empower developers around the world. We expect you to challenge the status quo, to care about the details, the end user, and how it all comes together. We are looking for enthusiastic developers to join as a member of this collaborative and friendly team. You should be someone with ideas and passion for software delivered as a service to maximize reuse, efficiency, and simplicity. Your work will impact millions of Apple users and is necessary to the success of some of the most visible current and future features.  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  
Experience with Observability solutions using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana  
  
Experience building Observability platforms is preferred  
  
Experience designing and using columnar storage  
  
Familiarity with time series database internals  
  
Passion for developing and testing clear, robust code  
  
Ability to learn and apply new technologies and frameworks.  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
  
BS or MS in CS or equivalent  
  
8+ years of industry experience  
  
Experience with Java  
  
Experience with designing, implementing and supporting highly scalable infrastructure services  
  
Deep understanding and work experience in distributed systems  
  
Deep understanding of core CS concepts including data structures, algorithms and concurrent programming  
  
Strong attention to detail and excellent analytical capabilities  
  
Great communication skills  
  
**Pay & Benefits**  
  
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $184,700 and $277,600, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. jobs.title: Robotics Engineer- Generalist
jobs.description:
**Robotics Engineer- Generalist**

**Location:** Santa Clara, CA

**Work Location**: In-Person | Full-time | Relocation not offered

**About HYFIX**

HYFIX Spatial Intelligence is building the next generation of autonomous drones and

robotic lawnmowers for dynamic, unstructured outdoor environments. Our systems

enable precision landscaping, spatial mapping, and property maintenance that scales

seamlessly, built on top of our proprietary RTK stack. We are developing fully

autonomous systems with no humans in the loop and are looking for a Robotics

Engineer to help shape the future of intelligent outdoor robotics.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a Robotics Engineer to own key parts of the robotics stack, including

navigation, perception, controls, software, and simulation. You will help guide how our

robots map, navigate, and operate in complex outdoor environments, ensuring that

behavior is rigorously validated in simulation before deployment in the field.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and enhance the robotics software stack from low-level vehicle control through high-level autonomy and spatial intelligence.
* Design and implement motion planning, coverage path planning, and real-time control systems for UAVs and UGVs operating in complex outdoor environments.
* Develop and maintain simulation environments in NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Gazebo, or Unreal Engine for algorithm validation and hardware-in-the-loop testing.
* Build perception pipelines using multi-camera setups, depth sensors, LiDAR, and RTK-GPS for obstacle avoidance, terrain mapping, and visual-inertial odometry.
* Architect controls and software frameworks for autonomous task execution and safe navigation without human intervention.
* Integrate computer vision models and sensor fusion algorithms (EKF/UKF) forsemantic environment understanding and object tracking.
* Define software interfaces between autonomy stacks, onboard compute systems, flight controllers, motor drivers, and mechanical systems. **Collaborate with mechanical and hardware engineering teams to optimize drive** systems, flight dynamics, actuator selection, and sensor placement.
* Support outdoor hardware testing, deployments, and commissioning in real-world environments.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
* 3 to 7years of experience in robotics software development focused on mobile robots,

UAVs, navigation, or perception.

* Strong proficiency in ROS2 and real-time Linux environments.
* Experience with vehicle kinematics, flight dynamics, and trajectory/path planning.
* Proficiency in Python and C++.
* Hands-on experience integrating, debugging, and commissioning robotic hardware in

the field.

**Preferred Skills & Experience**

* Experience with NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Gazebo, AirSim, or similar simulation platforms.
* Experience with ground vehicle navigation stacks (Nav2) or UAV flight controllers (PX4,

ArduPilot).

* Familiarity with SLAM, visual odometry, GPS/RTK integration, and point-cloud

processing.

* Experience deploying computer vision models on edge AI platforms such as NVIDIA

Jetson.

* Background in agricultural robotics, delivery drones, autonomous driving, or high-

reliability autonomous systems.

* Experience designing for fault tolerance, safe autonomy, and graceful degradation.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.

**Benefits**

* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* 401(k) with company matching
* Health, dental, and vision insurance **Dynamic startup environment with hands-on engineering opportunities**

**How to Apply**

* Please submit your resume and relevant project experience to: recruiting@hyfix.ai

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Are you comfortable with working on-site at our Santa Clara, CA location?

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
At Mace, our purpose is to redefine the boundaries of ambition. We believe in creating places that are responsible, bringing transformative impact to our people, communities, and societies across the globe. To learn more about our purpose, culture, and priorities, visit our strategy site.

Within our consult business we harness our unique combination of leading-edge practical expertise and project delivery consultancy to unlock the potential in every project.

**The Project:**

GDC is seeking an experienced Infrastructure Engineer to help maintain, secure, and improve the technology our employees rely on every day. This position combines hands-on systems administration, advanced technical support, security operations, and project work across Microsoft 365, endpoint management, networking, and cloud infrastructure.

The successful candidate will take ownership of complex issues, strengthen operational processes, and identify opportunities to improve reliability, security, and the employee experience. They will be resourceful and analytical, combining independent research, practical experience, and sound judgment to resolve unfamiliar problems.

This role requires someone who enjoys both building technology and helping people use it effectively. Clear communication, thorough documentation, and a service-oriented approach are essential.

**You’ll Be Responsible For:**

* Administer and maintain GDC’s computer systems, cloud services, file services, and supporting infrastructure.
* Provide Tier 2 and Tier 3 support for complex hardware, software, identity, connectivity, and application issues.
* Investigate recurring incidents, identify root causes, and implement lasting improvements.
* Support employee onboarding, role changes, and offboarding through timely device provisioning and access management.
* Coordinate with employees, IT colleagues, and vendors to resolve issues and deliver technology projects.
* Manage Windows 11 endpoints, including deployment, configuration, and provisioning through Microsoft Intune and Windows Autopilot.
* Maintain Dell hardware and other supported devices throughout their lifecycle, including inventory, replacement planning, and secure retirement.
* Administer Microsoft Entra ID, security groups, role-based access, multifactor authentication, and Conditional Access.
* Develop and maintain device compliance policies, configuration profiles, update rings, and application deployments.
* Maintain Group Policy baselines and support the planned transition to modern device management where appropriate.
* Support Apple device enrollment and management through Apple Business Manager and GDC’s device management platforms.
* Maintain identity and provisioning integrations with HR systems, such as ADP Workforce Now or Workday, as applicable.
* Administer Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and related Microsoft 365 services.
* Manage service configuration, licensing, permissions, and operational health.
* Partner with business stakeholders to improve collaboration, information access, and effective use of Microsoft 365.
* Support the evaluation and governed adoption of Microsoft Copilot, Power Apps, Fabric, and Microsoft Foundry in partnership with relevant business and technical owners.
* Apply least-privilege access and established security baselines across systems and endpoints.
* Help employees recognize phishing attempts, suspicious requests, and other common security threats.
* Use NinjaOne to monitor endpoints, manage patches, deploy software, and provide remote support.
* Coordinate vendor support, service commitments, renewals, and statements of work for assigned platforms.
* Support Global Relay administration and related retention or archiving requirements in coordination with designated business and compliance owners.
* Recommend improvements to system reliability, user experience, and IT efficiency.
* Communicate technical risks, options, and recommendations clearly to IT leadership and business stakeholders.

**You’ll need to have:**

* At least 10 years of progressively responsible experience in systems administration, IT infrastructure, or a related hands-on technical role.
* Strong experience administering Microsoft 365, including Entra ID, Intune, Exchange Online, Teams, and SharePoint Online.
* Hands-on experience with Windows 11, Windows Autopilot, Dell hardware, endpoint configuration, and device lifecycle management.
* Experience managing Cisco Meraki networking and security infrastructure.
* Strong understanding of identity and access management, Conditional Access, multifactor authentication, security groups, and Group Policy.
* Experience using NinjaOne or a comparable remote monitoring and management platform.
* Experience with endpoint security, security monitoring, patch management, and incident investigation.
* Demonstrated ability to provide Tier 2 and Tier 3 support and troubleshoot complex issues across endpoints, networks, and cloud services.
* Ability to develop and maintain PowerShell scripts or comparable automation.
* Strong documentation, organization, and prioritization skills.
* Ability to explain technical concepts to employees with varying levels of technical knowledge.
* Demonstrated ownership, sound judgment, attention to detail, and effectiveness during service disruptions.
* Experience with Apple Business Manager, Global Relay, and HR-driven identity or provisioning integrations.
* Experience with Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, Cisco Umbrella, or comparable security platforms.
* Experience supporting Microsoft Copilot, Power Apps, Fabric, or Microsoft Foundry.
* Experience implementing or supporting VDI or Azure Virtual Desktop.
* Familiarity with ITIL practices, NIST frameworks, CIS Microsoft 365 Benchmarks, and CISA SCuBA guidance.
* Relevant Microsoft, Cisco, CompTIA, security, or IT service management certifications.

new_jobs.title: Robotics Engineer- Generalist
new_jobs.description:
**Robotics Engineer- Generalist**

**Location:** Santa Clara, CA

**Work Location**: In-Person | Full-time | Relocation not offered

**About HYFIX**

HYFIX Spatial Intelligence is building the next generation of autonomous drones and

robotic lawnmowers for dynamic, unstructured outdoor environments. Our systems

enable precision landscaping, spatial mapping, and property maintenance that scales

seamlessly, built on top of our proprietary RTK stack. We are developing fully

autonomous systems with no humans in the loop and are looking for a Robotics

Engineer to help shape the future of intelligent outdoor robotics.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a Robotics Engineer to own key parts of the robotics stack, including

navigation, perception, controls, software, and simulation. You will help guide how our

robots map, navigate, and operate in complex outdoor environments, ensuring that

behavior is rigorously validated in simulation before deployment in the field.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and enhance the robotics software stack from low-level vehicle control through high-level autonomy and spatial intelligence.
* Design and implement motion planning, coverage path planning, and real-time control systems for UAVs and UGVs operating in complex outdoor environments.
* Develop and maintain simulation environments in NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Gazebo, or Unreal Engine for algorithm validation and hardware-in-the-loop testing.
* Build perception pipelines using multi-camera setups, depth sensors, LiDAR, and RTK-GPS for obstacle avoidance, terrain mapping, and visual-inertial odometry.
* Architect controls and software frameworks for autonomous task execution and safe navigation without human intervention.
* Integrate computer vision models and sensor fusion algorithms (EKF/UKF) forsemantic environment understanding and object tracking.
* Define software interfaces between autonomy stacks, onboard compute systems, flight controllers, motor drivers, and mechanical systems. **Collaborate with mechanical and hardware engineering teams to optimize drive** systems, flight dynamics, actuator selection, and sensor placement.
* Support outdoor hardware testing, deployments, and commissioning in real-world environments.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
* 3 to 7years of experience in robotics software development focused on mobile robots,

UAVs, navigation, or perception.

* Strong proficiency in ROS2 and real-time Linux environments.
* Experience with vehicle kinematics, flight dynamics, and trajectory/path planning.
* Proficiency in Python and C++.
* Hands-on experience integrating, debugging, and commissioning robotic hardware in

the field.

**Preferred Skills & Experience**

* Experience with NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Gazebo, AirSim, or similar simulation platforms.
* Experience with ground vehicle navigation stacks (Nav2) or UAV flight controllers (PX4,

ArduPilot).

* Familiarity with SLAM, visual odometry, GPS/RTK integration, and point-cloud

processing.

* Experience deploying computer vision models on edge AI platforms such as NVIDIA

Jetson.

* Background in agricultural robotics, delivery drones, autonomous driving, or high-

reliability autonomous systems.

* Experience designing for fault tolerance, safe autonomy, and graceful degradation.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.

**Benefits**

* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* 401(k) with company matching
* Health, dental, and vision insurance **Dynamic startup environment with hands-on engineering opportunities**

**How to Apply**

* Please submit your resume and relevant project experience to: recruiting@hyfix.ai

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Are you comfortable with working on-site at our Santa Clara, CA location?

Work Location: In person
